title: gochnatia microcephala var. buchii
intro: Gochnatia microcephala var. buchii, commonly known as Mexican tea or Yerba del Toro, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Gochnatia microcephala var. buchii include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
